**Zhu Shenglong**[a] (Chinese: 朱胜龙; born 25 January 2000) is a Chinese hurdler specializing in the 110 metres hurdles.
He was the 2023 Chinese Athletics Championships winner, and he has represented China at the 2023 World Athletics Championships and several other international competitions.
